label: Gothwal 2012
setting: Vision Rehabilitation Centres, LV Prasad Eye Institute, Hyderabad (low vision rehabilitation referrals)
diagnosis_mix: NR (diagnoses not reported; BCVA better eye >=20/60 17%, <20/60-20/200 58%, <20/200 25%; Table 2 p3)
recruitment: visually impaired adults (18+; BCVA better eye <20/60, or >=20/60 with restricted visual fields) referred to the Vision Rehabilitation Centres; sampling method and dates NR; 351 participants completed the instrument
notes: Rasch psychometric study, no sensitivity/specificity. Questionnaire given by trained interviewers face to face before examination (p2). VA: Bailey-Lovie logMAR chart, habitual and best-spectacle corrected, monocular and binocular (p2). Sex: 269 male (77%), 82 female (23%) (Table 2 p3). Mean better-eye logMAR 0.83 +/- 0.42 (Table 2 p3).
